image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a wooden cutting board featuring two meat cleavers. The foreground cleaver has a dark, patterned (possibly Damascus or carbon steel) rectangular blade and a wooden handle with visible rivets. Behind it lies a second, larger cleaver with a polished silver blade and a similar wooden handle. To the left, there is a piece of yellow dough being cut by a smaller, black-handled knife. In the background, a striped kitchen towel is partially visible.

The etching/pattern on the dark blade is slightly inconsistent in depth and clarity, appearing somewhat 'painted on' rather than physically etched, though this could also be a specific stylistic finish.
